viewing_check: Check hallmarks on every piece (lion passant, town, date letter): egg cup, salts, spoons, tray, thimble, button hook handle. Confirm tray and barrel are silver not plate, thimble metal, and weigh the lot if possible. Check for any marks of continental silver (800/835/925 only) and the extent of denting.
